## CFA 04 – Weekly Digest
Runs on a weekly schedule (every Monday 08:00) or on demand via webhook. Retrieves feedback from Google Sheets, deterministically aggregates and ranks the top 5 customer issues, uses Gemini AI to generate executive insights and recommended actions, dispatches a mobile-friendly HTML summary email via Gmail, logs execution history in the Digests sheet, and returns JSON for API triggers.
